title: Domain
description: An area of data a platform can be granted access to. Every other schema declares the domain it belongs to via its `domain` field, so granting a domain is what decides which record types a platform may touch. The permitted values are the `oneOf` list under `id` — this schema is the published list, not a copy of it.

id.description: Stable domain id, used in every schema’s `domain` field and in access grants.
